spec: HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md :: '## 3. VERDICTS - Q3' :: '### K-009' (Popper TESTABLE-NOW verdict, git 0a73fd2)
state_class: first-run (confirmatory scoring; prediction POST-registered, see pre_registration)

numerics_audit.note: mass < 1 is expected: footprint cells do not tile the whole box

estimator_saturation.note: If most of the null sits at a cap the statistic has no resolving power there and the comparison must not be read as a measurement.

rho_sta_partial.proxy: Mc(x,t) maximum-curvature completeness on 0.6-deg super-cells, +/-13-week window, from the sub-M2.5 SCSN catalog
rho_sta_partial.FLAG: K-031 station-density field rho_sta(x,t) is NOT on disk; this is a surrogate

positive_control.interpretation: Popper: 'the pipeline must recover both scales to within a factor of 2. This is what makes a null interpretable.' If no amplitude recovers both scales, a null K-009 result is NOT interpretable as 'there is no weather' -- it is only 'this pipeline could not have seen weather injected on mu at these amplitudes'.

envelope_crossing.definition: largest scale at which the real pooled curve stays above the ETAS-sim null 97.5th percentile
envelope_crossing.correlogram_note: the 0-10 km bin is empty at 0.2 deg resolution; the 35 km bin is negative in the data, a lattice-aliasing artifact of a regular grid, so the contiguous and last-above lengths differ and both are reported

robustness_excluding_2010.reason: the leading residual EOF is dominated by a single spike; the M7.2 El Mayor-Cucapah sequence (2010-04-04) falls in this window

rate_matched_null.criterion: sim event count within +-30% of the observed count

headline.PRIMARY_TIME_statement: residual correlation TIME > 52 weeks (364 d): the pooled residual ACF exceeds the ETAS-sim null 97.5th percentile at every lag from 1 to 52 weeks -- CENSORED, the spec's 52-week lag window is exhausted, so this is a LOWER BOUND
headline.PRIMARY_LENGTH_statement: residual correlation LENGTH: the pooled spatial correlogram exceeds the ETAS-sim null 97.5th percentile contiguously to 30 km and in 8 bins out to 110 km; e-folding fit L = 41.0 km; resolution floor ~18 km
headline.null_TIME_envelope_IS_DEGENERATE: the exponential-fit T is pinned at its cap for most of the null because a fitted slope <= 0 is meaningless when the null ACF amplitude is ~0; use PRIMARY_TIME
headline.LENGTH_resolution_floor_km: ~18 km: the shortest 0.2-deg cell-centre separation. Structure below this is invisible to the correlogram.

success_rule.quoted: Lag-1 weekly ACF excess >= 0.05 over the sim-null 97.5th percentile, and stable across the kernel swap, and surviving the rho_sta partial. Failure: excess inside the null envelope, or destroyed by the kernel swap or the rho_sta partial.

generator_discrimination.GENERATOR_VERDICT: W-003 FALSIFIED; consistent with W-001/W-002 but NOT sharply -- the measured T is a censored lower bound that overlaps the factor-2 band rather than landing inside it

pre_registration.smoke_test_disclosure: Two smoke-test runs of this script were executed BEFORE the two-generator ruling arrived, on a REDUCED 2-year sub-window (2010-01-01 .. 2012-01-01, not the spec's 2010-2018) with 2 simulations, to debug the pipeline. They printed measured residual correlation statistics, so the executing agent was NOT blind when the prediction was written. Seen in those debug runs: lag-1 pooled ACF approx +0.16 to +0.18, correlation time approx 9.8-10.2 weeks, correlation length approx 27-29 km, 2-sim null lag-1 ACF approx -0.015. The registered t_a prediction (27.6 weeks) was derived solely from train-window (<2010) aftershock stacking and lies OUTSIDE the seen sub-window value, but the ordering is violated and the result carries that caveat. Debug artifacts retained for audit: _smoke_k009.json, maps/_smoke_k009.png.

flags.n_sims_guard_reduced: runtime guard 90.0 min: 20 sims run instead of the spec's 500; recorded, not silently substituted
flags.world_arm_UNRUN: Popper's spec also mandates the world arm at 0.5 deg x 30 d over the 13 boxes. It was NOT run (runtime guard). This is UNRUN, not skipped: the SoCal verdict is therefore partial with respect to the frozen spec.
flags.rho_sta_surrogate_WEAKENS_SUCCESS: Popper's success rule requires the excess to survive the K-031 station-density partial. K-031 has not been run and rho_sta(x,t) is not on disk, so an Mc(x,t) completeness proxy was substituted. Any SUCCESS label from this run is correspondingly weakened and must not be reported as having cleared the mandated observer-nuisance control.
flags.kernel_swap_is_LOW_POWER: The background field supplies only a small fraction of the conditional intensity (triggered fraction of integrated intensity in EXP-H test = 0.909), so the three background fields produce nearly identical residuals. The kernel-swap control will pass almost regardless of the truth. It is reported as a weak control, and 'stable across the kernel swap' must NOT be read as strong evidence against kernel misfit.

sim_count_distribution_FIRST_CLASS.note: Branching ratio n = 1.161 is SUPERCRITICAL, so the free-running spatio-temporal ETAS need not reproduce the observed event count. A sim/obs count mismatch changes the residual noise level and would confound the null, so the distribution is reported as a primary diagnostic.

flags.K002_not_on_disk: no results_k002.json exists; the spatio-temporal ETAS required by Popper's fix #1 was built inside this script (background field and spatial kernel fit on the train window only)
